notes.title: The new and improved Angry Balls is finally here.
notes.content:
The new and improved Angry Balls is finally here.
Try it out on our new summer promotion and get hooked!

Game Summary :
Angry Ball VR is a Slingshot-Action-Puzzle-Shooter that will keep you on your toes!
Are you the hero of the legendary meowprophecy? Will you, with your Mighty Warrior Laser Slingshot, become the hero of Catworld ?!  
Grab your VR Headset and enter the world of adorable cats to get immersed in an exciting rescue mission.
Caution: Makes a family activity too exciting. Prepare popcorn in advance.

Now available on Steam.
Check out our website @  https://www.angryballvr.com/  for additional details.

Updates :
- Bug fixes
- Added features for Improved Gameplay flow
